speaker: Doctor
text: Let's begin with some basic questions. How long have you been experiencing this swelling and pain in your right ring finger, and is it getting worse over time? Have you noticed any redness, warmth, or stiffness in that specific finger?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like a significant forceful flexion injury. Did you notice any visible deformity or a "pop" at the moment of injury? Also, is the pain so severe you cannot fully extend or bend the finger?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your description of the finger being locked in extension with a history of forceful flexion, this sounds like a "Mallet Finger" or a potential "Jersey Finger" (avulsion of the flexor tendon).
